propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook lacks the prod instance ID and region, forcing operators to guess during SSM deployments.
The prod box region (us-east-1) is defined only in terraform var.aws_region and versions.tf, not in the operational runbook.
Operators need the instance ID (i-00880b2c7f13527c5), region (us-east-1), account ID, and SSM connection commands documented in the runbook for practical deployment.
The autodeploy.sh script body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync during deployments; only the installer and unit files are excluded from re-materialization.
Script-only changes to autodeploy.sh do not trigger a deploy and must be hand-deployed to take effect immediately.
